subject: Commit adjustment & throughput ramp — alignment, timeline, and QBR windows
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
To: Annika Sørensen <annika@clearmap.health>, procurement@clearmap.health
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Commit adjustment & throughput ramp — alignment, timeline, and QBR windows

Hi Annika —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our discussion you signaled interest in: a) moving to a 12-month term with a stepped commit, and b) increasing throughput headroom to cover seasonal peaks in Q4. I put together a short proposal and a few calendar options so we can lock the path and get procurement moving.

High-level proposal (attached):
- Term: amend current agreement to a 12-month term effective 2027-10-01; 2-step commit (base + seasonal burst).
- Throughput: +45% average token capacity across your production endpoints, plus a 2x burst pool for three peak weeks.
- Pricing: blended unit price with defined staircase pricing for the burst period (details in proposed_amendment_v1.pdf).

Action items I need from your side to proceed:
1) Confirm the procurement contact who will receive the DocuSign (is procurement@clearmap.health the right address?).
2) Confirm exec attendee list for an alignment readout with your CTO/product lead (we typically keep this under 30 mins).
3) Pick preferred QBR slot so we can include the new commitment in the agenda. Proposed windows:
   - Option A: Thu, Sep 23, 10:00-11:00 CEST
   - Option B: Mon, Sep 27, 14:00-15:00 CEST

Attached: Clearmap_usage_report_Jan-Jun2027.csv (usage baseline) and proposed_amendment_v1.pdf (redlineable).

If those slots don't work, send me two alternatives and Ben will handle calendar conflicts.

Thanks — aim is to have a signed amendment and a confirmed ops runbook before Oct 1 so our capacity changes line up with your Q4 forecast.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
_tessa.morgan@redwood.ai_

---
Attachment stubs: Clearmap_usage_report_Jan-Jun2027.csv (CSV, 42KB); proposed_amendment_v1.pdf (PDF, 128KB)

From: Annika Sørensen <annika@clearmap.health>

Subject: Re: Commit adjustment & throughput ramp — alignment, timeline, and QBR windows

Hi Tessa —

Thanks for the clear summary and for pulling the doc together. Quick answers below:

- Procurement: procurement@clearmap.health is correct (that's our legal/procurement alias). I'll loop in our legal lead if we need redlines, but procurement will be the primary recipient for DocuSign.
- Exec attendees: I'll have our CTO (Rasmus Lindqvist) attend and our Head of Product (Marta Ruiz) for the alignment readout; please keep it to 30 mins.
- QBR slots: Option B (Mon, Sep 27, 14:00 CEST) works best for the execs.

A few clarifying questions before we proceed:
1) Do you have an SOC 2 attestation copy or recent penetration test summary we can include in our procurement packet?
2) How fast can you provision the additional burst pool once the amendment is signed? We need the ramp aligned to the marketing campaign that starts Oct 10.
3) Can you also provide an updated invoice example that shows the staircase pricing for internal forecasting?

I'll ask procurement to expect the DocuSign and confirm our internal PO timeline. If you can share a one-pager that lays out the new traffic thresholds and fallbacks for the burst pool, that will help our infra ops review.

Annika
Director of Engineering Operations
Clearmap Health

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit adjustment & throughput ramp — alignment, timeline, and QBR windows

Tessa/Team —

Thanks — Annika's responses are clear. Proposed internal next steps and owners so we can move quickly:

1) Procurement & DocuSign (Owner: Lauren)
   - Lauren to prepare amendment doc (from proposed_amendment_v1.pdf), convert to DocuSign template, and include invoice example. Aim to send by EOD Thu (2027-09-16).
2) Security artifacts (Owner: Stephanie)
   - Attach SOC 2 Type II attestation and short pen-test summary to the procurement packet. If anything is redacted we should note that.
3) Ops runbook & burst configuration (Owner: Ben)
   - I'll draft the runbook entries for the burst pool (timeout/fallback rules, scaling triggers) and add a short one-pager for Annika's infra team. Draft ready by Fri morning.
4) Exec alignment & QBR prep (Owner: Tessa)
   - Tessa to schedule the Mon Sep 27 14:00 CEST slot and circulate a 15-min readout + 15-min Q&A agenda.

Attachments for internal: mutual_action_plan_clearmap.xlsx (contains milestone dates and responsibilities).

If we can have the amendment out by Thu and SOC2 artifacts attached, that should let procurement restart their PO process and aim to sign within 7 business days. I'll also put an internal calendar block to review any redlines.

Ben Carter
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
